systems.country_label: fibre optic infrastructure / mass fibre optic network
systems.platform: fibre, with last-mile connections by commercial internet service providers
systems.owner: Katsina State Government, coordinated by the Katsina State Investment Promotion Agency
systems.tiers: state level; consumer rollout to homes, businesses and public facilities announced 27 August 2026, with deployment frameworks across all 34 local government areas; roadmap of 2,000 to 3,000 km and 70% broadband penetration

note: A state government's consumer fibre rollout; the 34 local government areas are its geographic reach and 'public facilities' are not specified, so no local government office is said to be connected.
